# NPDM 声明系统资源 24 MB，IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled 为真（同 Engage）：StandardAllocator 在别名区一次分一整块（应用池 − 64 MB，按 1 GB 对齐），
# 较新 SDK 的 AddressRegionManager 还先占别名区开头约 1 GB 作节点区；HeapDef 里引擎自己的 VirtualAddressMemory 是 1.05 GB。
# 只在 Mac 上跑，地址空间不紧。实测（首次起机）：nninitStartup 还要 SetHeapSize 0x85c00000（2.09 GB），所以堆区给 2.25 GB；
# 别名区给 8 GB 放 StandardAllocator 的整块与节点区，应用池报真机的 3285 MB，起机后按 [内存] 日志实测再收
# The NPDM declares 24 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true (as in Engage): StandardAllocator takes one region in the alias region (application pool − 64 MB, 1 GB aligned),
# and newer SDKs' AddressRegionManager first takes about 1 GB at the start of the alias region as its node area; the engine's own VirtualAddressMemory in HeapDef is 1.05 GB.
# Mac only, so address space is not tight. Measured (first boot): nninitStartup also calls SetHeapSize for 0x85c00000 (2.09 GB), so the heap region gets 2.25 GB;
# the alias region gets 8 GB for StandardAllocator's region and the node area, with the hardware's 3285 MB application pool; trimmed after measuring with the [内存] log lines
# ---- NVN 驱动常量段（dmsh_build.py 出包、nvn_mtl.m 运行时现填） | NVN driver constant segments (dmsh_build.py at packaging, nvn_mtl.m filled at run time) ----
